## Requirements (from the contract)

1. `docs/build/tools/record_policy/living_records.toml` — living paths, frozen
   artifacts, CURRENT-STATE keys, status vocabulary, named-id patterns, the
   `living_record_invariant` registry with reasons. (SIG-ENG-040)
2. `tests/unit/test_no_living_record_pins.py` — the AST lint in `make check`:
   a real-tree test that reads a living path fails on (1) a CURRENT-STATE
   `key: value` literal, (2) an assertion that a named obligation/requirement/
   readout has a specific status, (3) `len(<living-derived>) == <int>`,
   (4) a literal row range or date. Allowed forms + the registered
   `@pytest.mark.living_record_invariant` escape hatch. Reports files/tests
   evaluated (> 0).
3. Convert or delete the remaining pins, each in its own commit, never relaxed:
   the three `living-pin?` warnings (test_build_memory_audit /
   test_closeout_protocol / test_current_projection — all tmp_path fixtures;
   the fix is superseding the shell heuristic with the lint), the
   `test_repo_docs_current_state.py` wording checks (move or delete), and
   whatever else the lint finds on first run.
4. Nightly advance backtest in `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` (read-only):
   real-tree tests from commit C replayed against the tree at the next
   first-parent commit C′ that changed a living record; the report names the
   test and the transition.
5. `tests/AGENTS.md` convention note: living control records are read only
   through the validators or a snapshot commit; a failing pin is converted or
   deleted, never relaxed.
